brief.meaningEn: A way of gaining insight into a subject, experience or way of life.
brief.meaningZh: 讓人深入了解某主題、經驗或生活方式的途徑。
brief.grammar: Offer/provide/open a window into/onto a subject or way of life; the source also uses a small window to another culture for limited insight. Into and onto are the more established general choices; do not extend to every literal window to a place.
brief.register: A reviewer or guide can use this conventional insight metaphor with readers or visitors; window to another culture is a less usual contextual variant, so the lesson keeps that form bounded to culture rather than teaching it as a free substitute for into.
brief.boundaryZh: 只提供一個局部視角，不代表整個文化；來源的 a small window to another culture 可在這個語境表示洞見，但一般寫作宜優先用較常見的 window into。不是本課的實際建築窗口。
brief.misconceptionZh: 個人日記可有價值但仍只是一人的視角，需與其他來源對照。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述資料帶來的理解及局限，區分局部洞見與完整代表。

listening.en: The apprentice’s diary offers a window into daily workshop life, but it records one person’s experience rather than everyone’s.
listening.zh: 學徒日記提供了解工場日常生活的窗口，但記錄的是一人的經驗，不是所有人的。
listening.promptZh: 說話者怎樣看日記的價值？

options.en: It helps us understand workshop life from one person’s perspective.
options.zh: 它幫我們從一人視角了解工場生活。

options.en: It is a complete record of every worker’s experience.
options.zh: 它是每位工人經歷的完整記錄。

options.en: It contains no insight because it was written by only one person.
options.zh: 它只由一人寫，所以完全沒有洞見。

options.en: It replaces the need to compare any other accounts.
options.zh: 它取代對照其他敘述的需要。

listening.explanationZh: window 提供洞見，but 保留一人視角；局部來源仍可有價值。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼你想把學徒日記放入工場歷史展？
reply.promptEn: Why would you include the apprentice’s diary in the workshop-history exhibition?

options.en: It shows details of ordinary work from someone who was there.
options.zh: 它由在場者展示平常工作的細節。

options.en: It offers a window into workshop life.
options.zh: 它提供了解工場生活的窗口。

options.en: Visitors can learn how one apprentice experienced the day.
options.zh: 訪客可了解一位學徒怎樣經歷一天。

options.en: It provides a personal perspective that can sit alongside other accounts.
options.zh: 它提供可與其他敘述並列的個人視角。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都說明可帶來的理解；金句未聲稱全面代表。

scene.promptZh: 一本社區食譜書記錄某節日的一道菜及幾個家庭如何準備。一位來自另一文化背景、對該節日不熟悉的讀者從中認識一項習俗，但仍不知道該文化中每個家庭的做法。哪句準確？

options.en: The recipe proves that every household in that culture celebrates in exactly the same way.
options.zh: 這份食譜證明該文化中每個家庭的慶祝方式完全相同。

options.en: The recipe offers a small window to another culture, but it cannot represent every household.
options.zh: 這份食譜讓人窺見另一種文化的一小部分，但不能代表每個家庭。

options.en: The recipe offers no cultural insight because it describes only one dish.
options.zh: 這份食譜只描述一道菜，所以完全不能提供文化洞見。

scene.explanationZh: 一道菜可帶來局部洞見，卻不足以代表所有家庭；有限不等於沒有價值。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個理解最超出 a window into 的意思？

options.en: A source may reveal useful details of an unfamiliar experience.
options.zh: 來源可揭示陌生經驗的有用細節。

options.en: One perspective can be compared with other evidence.
options.zh: 一個視角可與其他證據比較。

options.en: The source automatically gives a complete and unbiased account of the whole subject.
options.zh: 來源自動給出整個主題完整而無偏見的敘述。

contrast.explanationZh: 洞見窗口不是全面保證，仍要看來源範圍及立場。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說「日記是 a window into 工場生活，所以毋須看工人訪談」。哪句回應最好？

options.en: The diary offers a window into factory life, but interviews may add experiences the writer did not share.
options.zh: 日記讓人窺見工場生活的一面，但訪談可能補充作者未曾經歷的事。

options.en: Let us use the diary’s detail as proof that no other account could matter.
options.zh: 把日記細節當作沒有其他敘述重要的證據吧。

options.en: One apprentice’s routine is a complete account of every worker’s experience.
options.zh: 一位學徒的習慣就是每位工人經驗的完整敘述。

dialogue.explanationZh: 來源有洞見與需要補充可同時成立。

speaking.en: These letters offer a window into one family’s everyday life.
speaking.zh: 這些信提供了解一個家庭日常生活的窗口。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再描述資料帶來的視角及範圍。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你想了解舞台燈光工作，跟隨劇院團隊觀察一個早上的準備，看到分工及排練安排。你想描述職業體驗的洞見，也說明一次探訪未代表整份工作。用一至兩句英文寫出。

examples.en: The morning with the lighting team offered a window into backstage work, though one visit could not show every part of the job.
examples.zh: 跟燈光團隊的一個早上，提供了解幕後工作的窗口，但一次探訪無法呈現工作每一部分。

examples.en: Observing the preparations gave me a window into the team’s daily responsibilities; I would need further visits to understand the wider role.
examples.zh: 觀察準備讓我有了解團隊日常職責的窗口；要理解較完整角色，我還需更多探訪。

writing.selfCheckZh: 把直接觀察的職業洞見與一次體驗限制連起來，不把局部觀察當完整代表。

takeaways.en: A photograph can offer a window into a past way of life.
takeaways.zh: 照片可以提供了解過往生活方式的窗口。

takeaways.en: An interview can offer a small window to another culture without telling its whole story.
takeaways.zh: 一段訪談可讓人窺見另一種文化的一小部分，但不能講述其全部故事。

sources.sentence: With support, more people may lean into healthy habits.

sources.sentence: The festival decided to lean into its local character.
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 7, row 17; page is the locally rendered PDF page. Proposal-only same-sense variant; exact source wording retained as provenance.

brief.meaningEn: Deliberately embrace and develop a quality or practice instead of merely noticing it or resisting it; engagement does not itself prove a successful result.
brief.meaningZh: 有意識地擁抱並發展一種特質或做法，而非只注意到它或抗拒它；投入本身不證明已有成果。
brief.grammar: Lean/leans/leaned/leant/leaning into healthy habits or its/their local character. Into takes the quality or practice being actively embraced; the source personifies a festival as choosing to emphasise its local identity.
brief.register: A coach can use this contemporary, somewhat informal phrasal verb with a learner about habits; a festival organiser can use it with colleagues about local identity. The objects are contextual uses of the same verb, not fixed idioms requiring those exact nouns.
brief.boundaryZh: 說明主動投入或強調某特質，不保證健康已有改善，也不表示地方特色是唯一值得保留的面向；須看實際行動。
brief.misconceptionZh: 收藏目標清單不等於投入健康習慣；活動以地方特色設計內容，也不等於拒絕所有新元素。
brief.outcomeZh: 能從具體行動判斷某人或機構是否主動擁抱習慣或地方特色，並避免誇大結果。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: Oxford lean into attests accepting a challenge and trying hard. Healthy habits is a contextual object, not a separate fixed idiom. Fictional personal routines illustrate engagement without prescribing a regimen.

listening.en: In the novel, Sam decided to lean into healthy habits rather than keep collecting advice: he planned his own lunch break and asked a friend to help him protect that time during busy weeks.
listening.zh: 小說中，森決定更主動投入健康習慣，而非只收集資訊：他安排自己的午餐休息，並請朋友幫他在忙周保留時間。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 他開始具體投入自己的日常目標，而非只收資訊。
他已得到所有習慣改善身體的實測結果。
他只在收集更多資訊，未想落實任何安排。
朋友替他決定所有生活選擇，沒有問他的目標。

listening.explanationZh: planned 與 asked 表現主動投入；未給身體成效或朋友代作全部決定。

reply.promptEn: What changed in Sam’s approach to his daily goals?
reply.promptZh: 森對日常目標的做法有甚麼改變？

options.en: He began to lean into healthy habits by protecting a lunch break he had chosen.
options.zh: 他保留自己選的午餐休息，開始更主動投入健康習慣。

options.en: He moved from collecting advice to making a specific arrangement.
options.zh: 他由收集資訊，轉為作具體安排。

options.en: He asked for practical support to keep time for his own routine.
options.zh: 他請求實際支援，為自己的習慣保留時間。

options.en: His plan involved participation rather than simply storing suggestions.
options.zh: 他的計劃涉及參與，而非只儲存建議。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 社區書店不再只用連鎖店的統一陳列，開始展示本區作者的書，並讓居民選擇口述歷史活動的題目；它仍出售其他書籍。哪句貼切？

options.en: The bookshop is leaning into its local character through specific choices, without excluding every other kind of book.
options.zh: 書店透過具體安排更主動突出自身的地方特色，但沒有排除所有其他類型的書。

options.en: The bookshop has kept only the same chain-store display and made no local choices.
options.zh: 書店只保留原有的連鎖店式陳列，沒有作出任何地方特色的安排。

options.en: The local display proves that every resident now prefers the same books.
options.zh: 地方主題陳列證明所有居民現在都喜歡相同的書。

scene.explanationZh: 展示本區作者及讓居民選題，是主動突出地方特色；並無證據說其他書被排除或所有人喜好相同。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 lean into healthy habits 得出？

options.en: 更主動參與相關日常安排。
單憑這用語已知個人的健康指標改善。
情境應交代習慣及投入方式，不只用抽象標語。

contrast.explanationZh: 投入描述不等於健康結果數據。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「他只有午餐休息計劃，哪能說成效已證實？」你本來只說他開始投入。哪句澄清較準確？

options.en: I said he was starting to lean into healthy habits, not that the story had proved a health result.
options.zh: 我說他開始更主動投入健康習慣，不是故事已證健康成效。

options.en: Count the new plan itself as the measured improvement, without waiting for any observation.
options.zh: 不用等觀察，把新計劃本身算作已量度改善。

options.en: Because no result is reported, leave out the concrete effort he has already made.
options.zh: 既沒報成果，就不提他已作的具體努力。

dialogue.explanationZh: 投入可真實存在而結果未報，不把兩者合併，也不抹去努力。

speaking.en: He wanted to lean into healthy habits by making room for the routine he had chosen, rather than just saving more advice.
speaking.zh: 他想為自己選的安排留空間，更主動投入健康習慣，而非只儲存更多資訊。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再分清投入行動與結果。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：故事中，你與朋友自己選了下班後到公園散步作日常目標，朋友願陪你，也尊重你有時需改時間。你想感謝陪伴，承諾自己提早核哪天可行、若加班先聯絡，而不只談新器材或讓朋友追着問。用一至兩句英文表達主動投入。

examples.en: Thank you for joining the walks we chose; I want to lean into healthy habits by taking responsibility for our shared arrangements. I will check the time in advance and let you know if work changes.
examples.zh: 謝謝你參與我們選的散步；我想負責共同安排，更主動投入健康習慣。我會提早核時間，若工作改動便告訴你。

examples.en: Your company encourages me to lean into healthy habits rather than only discuss new equipment. I can help plan the park visits and contact you early when we need another time.
examples.zh: 你的陪伴鼓勵我更主動投入健康習慣，而不只談新器材。我可幫安排公園散步，需另選時間時及早聯絡你。

writing.selfCheckZh: 感謝已選共同活動的支持，以自己提早安排及聯絡作投入，不把參與意願當健康結果已證或把責任全交朋友。

takeaways.en: She began to lean into healthy habits by discussing which of her chosen routines she could realistically keep.
takeaways.zh: 她討論自己選的哪些安排實際可維持，開始更主動投入健康習慣。

takeaways.en: The bookshop leaned into its local character by featuring neighbourhood writers beside the usual titles.
takeaways.zh: 書店在一般書目旁重點展示本區作家的作品，更主動突出自身的地方特色。

author.method: Individually authored bilingual lesson draft; structural validation is separate from editorial approval.

review.note: Proposal only: active-embrace object expansion for book10-16-0099; no claim that healthy outcomes or local audience approval are proved. Independent owner review needed.

lessons.titleZh: 稍有喘息與調整的空間

brief.meaningEn: Enough time or freedom to ease pressure and continue working or adapting; being given the chance to breathe describes receiving that opportunity.
brief.meaningZh: 獲得足夠時間或自由，稍減壓力並繼續工作或調整；being given the chance to breathe 指得到這樣的機會。
brief.grammar: Room/space to breathe names the available leeway; be given the/a chance to breathe describes being allowed it. The second construction is passive in the source and does not guarantee success or the removal of every constraint.
brief.register: A colleague or organiser can use this figurative pressure-relief language with a team discussing schedules or creative constraints. The source personifies traditional makers but refers to people’s freedom to adapt; literal breathing and breathe new life into are different uses.
brief.boundaryZh: 得到喘息及調整機會，不等於完全不用履行責任，也不是字面呼吸困難或 breathe new life into 的「注入新活力」。
brief.misconceptionZh: 喘息空間不等於放棄目標；合理留白可以幫人維持工作及生活。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述安排如何減輕壓力，同時保留仍有責任。

listening.en: Moving one deadline gave the team room to breathe: they could check the draft carefully instead of rushing between two tasks.
listening.zh: 把一個期限移後讓小組有喘息空間：他們可仔細查草稿，不用在兩項工作間趕來趕去。

options.en: It cancelled every task so nobody had responsibilities.
options.zh: 它取消所有工作，沒有人再需負責。

options.en: It added another urgent task to the same crowded period.
options.zh: 它在同一擠迫時段加入另一急事。

options.en: It eased the immediate pressure enough for a careful check.
options.zh: 它減輕即時壓力，讓人能仔細查核。

options.en: It showed that the team had already abandoned the project.
options.zh: 它顯示小組已放棄項目。

listening.explanationZh: 查草稿仍是責任，只是安排不再如此趕迫；不是全取消。

reply.promptZh: 把其中一個期限移後對小組有甚麼幫助？
reply.promptEn: How did moving one deadline help the team?

options.en: It gave them enough time to check the draft carefully.
options.zh: 它給他們足夠時間仔細查草稿。

options.en: It gave them room to breathe.
options.zh: 它給他們喘息空間。

options.en: They no longer had to rush between both tasks at once.
options.zh: 他們不再需同時在兩項工作間趕來趕去。

options.en: The revised schedule reduced the pressure without dropping the work.
options.zh: 修訂時間表減輕壓力，同時沒有放棄工作。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都說明減壓及留時間；金句是安排空間的比喻。

scene.promptZh: 一個劇團原須翌日交出舞台設計，主辦方改為給設計師兩周試作及修改；演出日期和安全規定仍然保留。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The designers have been given the chance to breathe while revising, without abandoning the production.
options.zh: 設計師在修改時獲得喘息空間，但劇團沒有放棄演出。

options.en: The extra time means the production has been cancelled and no design is needed.
options.zh: 多出的時間表示演出已取消，不再需要任何設計。

options.en: The organizers removed every safety requirement as soon as the deadline changed.
options.zh: 主辦方一改期限便取消了所有安全規定。

scene.explanationZh: 延長試作及修改時間帶來喘息與調整機會；原定演出和安全要求仍在。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句最不宜由 room to breathe 得出？

options.en: Some pressure or restriction has eased.
options.zh: 部分壓力或限制減輕了。

options.en: There may be more time to think or prepare.
options.zh: 可能有更多時間思考或準備。

options.en: All responsibility has disappeared and no further action is needed.
options.zh: 所有責任已消失，不需再採取行動。

contrast.explanationZh: 喘息指足夠空間，不等於任務全無或工作完成。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說「你想 room to breathe，就是不想完成項目」。哪句回應最好？

options.en: Let us treat a request for a realistic schedule as withdrawal from the project.
options.zh: 把合理時間表要求當作退出項目吧。

options.en: I need room to breathe so I can do the work properly; I am not dropping the commitment.
options.zh: 我需要一點喘息空間，才能把工作做好；我沒有放棄承諾。

options.en: The number of overlapping deadlines alone measures how committed you are.
options.zh: 單憑期限重疊數目，便可衡量你有多投入。

dialogue.explanationZh: 調整壓力可支持完成目標，不由留白推斷放棄。

speaking.en: A short gap between tasks gives us room to breathe.
speaking.zh: 工作之間的短空檔給我們喘息空間。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再描述安排中的合理留白。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：美術社原要求每個人照同一樣板逐步複製，現在容許學生在核心主題內自行選材料，讓大家探索但仍須完成作品。用一至兩句英文描述多了創作自由，而非取消要求。

examples.en: Choosing our own materials gives us room to breathe creatively while we still work within the shared theme.
examples.zh: 自行選材料給我們創作上的喘息空間，同時仍在共同主題內工作。

examples.en: The revised art brief gives students room to breathe without removing the need to complete a piece that fits the main theme.
examples.zh: 修訂的美術要求給學生喘息空間，同時未刪去完成符合主要主題作品的需要。

writing.selfCheckZh: 指出選材料的創作自由，保留核心主題及完成責任；不把 room to breathe 只當完全沒有要求。

takeaways.en: A less crowded schedule gives the family room to breathe.
takeaways.zh: 較少擠迫的時間表給家庭喘息空間。

takeaways.en: Leaving one afternoon unplanned gives the class space to breathe and test its own ideas.
takeaways.zh: 預留一個下午不排滿活動，讓全班有空間自主嘗試想法。

english.evidence: Read every model, option and example for sense, grammar, contextual fit and target morphology; not independent human approval.

chinese.evidence: Traditional Chinese translations checked against each English sentence; not independent human approval.

review.note: Proposal only: bounded passive chance-to-breathe variant for book10-16-2372; same pressure-relief decision as room/space to breathe, pending independent naturalness review.
